name: Velocity
description: Velocity, the modern Minecraft proxy, with a version/family selector and SHA-256-verified boot updater.
author: tommasobenatti@users.noreply.github.com

installation.content:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
cd /mnt/server
update_velocity() {
  command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  selector="${VELOCITY_VERSION}"
  project_json=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/velocity") || return 1
  if [ "$selector" = "latest" ]; then
    candidates=$(printf '%s' "$project_json" | jq -er '.versions | to_entries[] | .value[]') || return 1
  elif printf '%s' "$project_json" | jq -e --arg selector "$selector" '.versions[$selector] != null' >/dev/null; then
    candidates=$(printf '%s' "$project_json" | jq -er --arg selector "$selector" '.versions[$selector][]') || return 1
  else
    candidates="$selector"
  fi
  selected=""
  for candidate in $candidates; do
    candidate_builds=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/velocity/versions/$candidate/builds") || continue
    if [ "$(printf '%s' "$candidate_builds" | jq -r 'length')" -gt 0 ]; then
      selected="$candidate"
      builds_json="$candidate_builds"
      break
    fi
  done
  [ -n "$selected" ] || return 1
  build_json=$(printf '%s' "$builds_json" | jq -ec '([.[] | select(.channel == "STABLE")][0] // .[0])') || return 1
  build=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.id') || return 1
  url=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.downloads["server:default"].url') || return 1
  sha256=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.downloads["server:default"].checksums.sha256') || return 1
  release="$selected-$build"
  current=$(cat .velocity-build 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$current" = "$release" ] && [ -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Velocity Updater] Build $release is already installed."
    return 0
  fi
  echo "[Velocity Updater] Downloading Velocity $selected build $build..."
  curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o "$jar.download" "$url" || return 1
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha256" "$jar.download" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || return 1
  mv -f "$jar.download" "$jar" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$release" > .velocity-build
  echo "[Velocity Updater] Velocity $release installed and SHA-256 verified."
}
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE}"
if ! update_velocity; then
  rm -f "$jar.download"
  echo "[Velocity Installer] ERROR: unable to install Velocity."
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -s velocity.toml ]; then
  curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o velocity.toml "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PaperMC/Velocity/dev/3.0.0/proxy/src/main/resources/default-velocity.toml" || true
fi
mkdir -p .pterodactyl
cat > .pterodactyl/velocity-start.sh <<'PTERO_VELOCITY_START'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
cd /home/container || exit 1
update_velocity() {
  command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
  selector="${VELOCITY_VERSION:-3.0.0}"
  project_json=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/velocity") || return 1
  if [ "$selector" = "latest" ]; then
    candidates=$(printf '%s' "$project_json" | jq -er '.versions | to_entries[] | .value[]') || return 1
  elif printf '%s' "$project_json" | jq -e --arg selector "$selector" '.versions[$selector] != null' >/dev/null; then
    candidates=$(printf '%s' "$project_json" | jq -er --arg selector "$selector" '.versions[$selector][]') || return 1
  else
    candidates="$selector"
  fi
  selected=""
  for candidate in $candidates; do
    candidate_builds=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/velocity/versions/$candidate/builds") || continue
    if [ "$(printf '%s' "$candidate_builds" | jq -r 'length')" -gt 0 ]; then
      selected="$candidate"
      builds_json="$candidate_builds"
      break
    fi
  done
  [ -n "$selected" ] || return 1
  build_json=$(printf '%s' "$builds_json" | jq -ec '([.[] | select(.channel == "STABLE")][0] // .[0])') || return 1
  build=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.id') || return 1
  url=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.downloads["server:default"].url') || return 1
  sha256=$(printf '%s' "$build_json" | jq -er '.downloads["server:default"].checksums.sha256') || return 1
  release="$selected-$build"
  current=$(cat .velocity-build 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$current" = "$release" ] && [ -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Velocity Updater] Build $release is already installed."
    return 0
  fi
  echo "[Velocity Updater] Downloading Velocity $selected build $build..."
  curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o "$jar.download" "$url" || return 1
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha256" "$jar.download" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || return 1
  mv -f "$jar.download" "$jar" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$release" > .velocity-build
  echo "[Velocity Updater] Velocity $release installed and SHA-256 verified."
}
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-velocity.jar}"
auto_update="${AUTO_UPDATE:-1}"
if [ "$auto_update" = "1" ] || [ "$auto_update" = "true" ]; then
  if ! update_velocity; then
    rm -f "$jar.download"
    if [ ! -s "$jar" ]; then echo "[Velocity Updater] ERROR: update failed and no runnable JAR exists."; exit 1; fi
    echo "[Velocity Updater] WARNING: update failed; starting the existing JAR."
  fi
else
  echo "[Velocity Updater] Automatic updates are disabled."
  if [ ! -s "$jar" ]; then
    echo "[Velocity Updater] ERROR: $jar does not exist."
    exit 1
  fi
fi
if [ ! -s velocity.toml ]; then
  curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 -H "User-Agent: TommasoBenatti-Pterodactyl-Eggs/1.0 (https://github.com/tommasobenatti)" -o velocity.toml "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PaperMC/Velocity/dev/3.0.0/proxy/src/main/resources/default-velocity.toml" || exit 1
fi
sed -i -E 's|^bind[[:space:]]*=.*$|bind = "0.0.0.0:'"${SERVER_PORT:-25565}"'"|' velocity.toml
exec java ${JAVA_FLAGS:--Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=95.0 -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=4M -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch -XX:MaxInlineLevel=15} -jar "$jar"
PTERO_VELOCITY_START
chmod 755 .pterodactyl/velocity-start.sh

variables.name: Velocity Version or Family
variables.description: Exact version (for example 3.4.0 or 3.6.0-SNAPSHOT), family (3.0.0), or latest. A family follows the newest available version/build in that family.

variables.name: Velocity JAR File
variables.description: JAR filename used by the updater and startup command.

variables.name: Update on Boot
variables.description: Download the latest Velocity build for the selected version/family before every start. If the API is unavailable, the last verified JAR is retained.

variables.name: JVM Flags
variables.description: Velocity's recommended G1 flags combined with Pterodactyl-aware memory sizing.
